The '''InstaMist Generator''' was a [[Fire/Legends|fire]] suppression device produced by the company [[Agrierd Intergalactics]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The device functioned by expelling fire-extinguishing mist that settled into a foam which smothered flames. They were sold for 15 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]], with additional cartridges costing 10 credits.

==Description==
The InstaMist Generator was a cylindrical [[Fire/Legends|fire]] suppression device produced by the company [[Agrierd Intergalactics]]. The mist generator was simple in design, expelling the contents of a high pressure cartridge when pressure was applied to a handle at the end of the device. The cartridge, which required replacement after each use, normally generated a fire-extinguishing mist that settled into a foam capable of smothering flames. They could also be used to create a smog thick enough to conceal the user, which could be used to cover an escape.<ref name="GFT" />

==History==
The technology supply company [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] sold the generators through their [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|product datalog]] between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The devices were 15 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each, with replacement cartridges priced at 10 credits. The item was frequently available in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. On some [[Desert/Legends|desert]] worlds, [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] used InstaMist Generators equipped with [[Water/Legends|water]] vapor cartridges to simulate the reactions necessary to extract water from rock veins.<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The InstaMist Generator was included in a list of equipment and pictured in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'',<ref name="GFT" /> a sourcebook released in [[April]] [[1995]]<ref name="RS">{{Rebelscum|url=jedijournals/booktitle.asp?id=MDA2173|text=Jedi Journals Books on Rebelscum.com|author=Shepard, Jay}}</ref> by [[West End Games]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. It was designed by [[Michael Kogge]] for [[The Fantastic Technology Contest]], and the entry received an honorable mention.<ref name="GFT" />
